purpose: Exercise the current production structured question-generation wire once with Standard and once with Premium before any 180-assignment campaign is admitted.
nonClaims: The two rows cannot estimate quality, compare models, select a prompt profile, or establish endpoint reliability.
A successful micro-pilot does not authorize the S1 v6 campaign.
A failed or rejected started assignment is never replayed or replaced.
admissionHolds: Independent hostile corpus audit must pass without a fatal source defect.
Both assignments must be compiled through the current production core into byte-sealed exact-wire registries.
A public OpenRouter endpoint snapshot captured no more than 15 minutes before the first lease must bind the exact google-vertex/global tag, supported parameters, model slug, and price.
A durable controller must reserve one candidate, one fetch, and the per-call cost ceiling separately for each assignment and a shared two-call campaign ceiling.
The live child process must have exactly one OpenRouter credential source and must never print, hash, label, or persist the credential.
No other question-quality campaign call may be in flight.
The private output directory must be git-ignored and the public result must contain no prompt, passage, question, explanation, response body, provider generation id, or credential-shaped value.

credentialPolicy.microPilotExceptionReason: Only two serial no-retry calls carrying newly composed PII-free text are permitted; the exception is never inherited by S1.

accounting.debitRule: Debit one candidate opportunity immediately when a live provider fetch lease starts, including timeout, provider failure, parse failure, validation rejection, or an empty result.
accounting.costRule: Record returned usage cost when available and retain the reserved maximum for missing or non-final usage; never infer zero cost from a failed client parse.
